sections.title: 1. Introduction & Module Overview
sections.intro:
Night Audit din ka business close karne ka process hai — hotel ka 'day end'. Raat ko ek designated auditor ye karta hai:

1. Saare outlets ke settlements verify karna 2. In-house guests pe room charges + plan meals post karna 3. Departures/no-shows handle karna 4. Reports (Daily Report, FOCC) print karna 5. Software date aage badhana (rollover).

Analysis HMS me Night Audit ek guided process hai — Charges Posting (Shift+C) se shuru hota hai aur Night Audit Process (Shift+N) se complete hota hai. Galat ho jaye to Reverse Night Audit se rollback kiya ja sakta hai.

subsections.title: 2.1 Charges Posting (Shift+C)
subsections.paragraph: Night audit ka pehla step — saare in-house rooms pe aaj ka room rent + plan meals (CP/MAP/AP ke hisaab se) automatically post hota hai. Extra charges (restaurant, laundry) already folio me hote hain. Yahan se manual charge bhi post ho sakta hai.

subsections.title: 2.2 Night Audit Process (Shift+N) — Main Process
subsections.navPath: Night Audit ▶ Operation ▶ Night Audit Process
subsections.paragraph: Day close ka master wizard — step by step checks chalte hain: pending KOTs, unsettled bills, no-show processing, room charge posting verify, date rollover. Har step pass hone ke baad hi next step hota hai.

subsections.title: 2.3 Reverse Night Audit
subsections.navPath: Night Audit ▶ Operation ▶ Reverse Night Audit
subsections.paragraph: Galti se audit ho gaya (koi charge miss/post galat)? Reverse se pichhle audit rollback hota hai — date wapas aati hai, corrections karo, phir dobara audit. Restricted permission hoti hai (manager/admin).

subsections.title: 2.4 Account Posting
subsections.paragraph: Day ke revenue heads ko finance ke ledger accounts me post karna — room revenue, F&B revenue, tax heads. Ye FO/POS aur Finance module ka bridge hai.

subsections.title: 4.1 Audit Logs
subsections.paragraph: Night Audit Log: kab kaunsa audit hua, kisne kiya, kitni date aage badhi. Charges Remove Log: kaunsa charge kisne remove kiya — audit control. Ye dono dispute/audit ke waqt evidence hote hain.

subsections.title: 4.2 GSTR-1
subsections.paragraph: GSTR-1 format me invoice-wise outward supply data — accountant ise JSON/Excel me export karke GST portal pe file karta hai. B2B (company GSTIN) aur B2C alag sections me aate hain.
